summary: Retired engineer: split digital asset ownership & policy exception request for partial device retention
description:
Issue summary: HR submitted an offboarding request for a recently retired senior engineer (emp: E-12244) who is requesting to retain their company laptop for a 6-month advisory arrangement. The laptop contains a local encrypted disk image and cached credentials for a small set of service accounts used by the engineer for legacy maintenance tasks.

Impact: Potential risk of lingering access to service accounts, SSO tokens, and KMS-wrapped secrets if keys/credentials are not rotated. Policy question: can we approve a timeboxed asset retention while ensuring no elevated access remains and KMS ownership for affected secrets is transferred or rekeyed?

Environment: production identity & secrets posture across us-west and eu-west (employee had sessions / keys in both regions).

Steps to reproduce / immediate checks performed: 1) HR flagged retention request via offboarding workflow; 2) IT performed hardware inventory check and confirmed serial number SN-7F3B2; 3) Security reviewed last-login and verified the laptop reported last MDM check-in 2026-03-05; 4) IAM audit run (last 90 days) for service principals touched by emp E-12244: found 3 service accounts with long-lived keys and 2 SSH deploy keys in GitHub org.

Logs / evidence: SSO session logs (OKTA) attached reference: slack #security-thread-emp-E-12244. IAM audit export: s3://redwood-internal-audit/2026-03-09/emp-E-12244-iam.csv. KMS key list: two customer-managed keys in us-west-2 (cmk-az1) and eu-west-1 (cmk-b2) that were used for encrypting backups accessed by the engineer.

Requested outcome: HR asks for a documented exception to allow laptop retention for knowledge transfer and ad-hoc consulting while security/IT performs access sanitization and key rotation. Provide clear checklist of controls that must be completed before approval, and an owner to sign off on the exception.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - HR (J. Liu): Received retention request from retiree. Wants to keep machine for 6 months to support migration. Asking for IT/Sec checklist and decision.

2026-03-10 14:03 - IT (M. Rodriguez): Performed serial check and MDM report. Laptop model T14, disk encrypted with company MDM. Found last successful MDM heartbeat 2026-03-05. Blocking action until all accounts/keys are rotated.

2026-03-11 09:21 - Security (L. Nguyen): IAM audit shows 3 service principals with long-lived credentials and 2 GitHub deploy keys. Recommend rotate KMS keys or re-encrypt backups, revoke stale tokens, and create a signed exception doc if retention approved. See slack thread #security-hr.

2026-03-11 11:40 - IT (M. Rodriguez): Proposed checklist: (1) Disable interactive login via SSO for emp; (2) Rotate service-account keys & replace deploy keys in GitHub; (3) Re-encrypt impacted backups with new CMKs and retire old keys or change key policy; (4) Enforce MDM configuration baseline and install a remote wipe trigger; (5) Sign timebound retention SLA with HR and Security. Requesting Sec lead sign-off.

2026-03-12 08:55 - Security (K. Patel): Agreed to steps 1-4. Will own the key rewrap in eu-west and us-west. We propose a 30-day hard deadline instead of 6 months for company asset retention; longer retention can be negotiated under consulting contract terms.
2026-03-12 12:01 - HR (J. Liu): Noted. Will update retiree offer letter for 30-day retention window and advisor consulting conversion if needed. Awaiting final sign-off to release asset.
investigation_notes: IAM audit details: service-princ-analytics (svc-ana) had an access key last used 2026-02-14; svc-backups had role with access to two backup buckets encrypted by cmk-az1 and cmk-b2. GitHub: two deploy keys tied to repo infra-config with write access created 2021. MDM shows disk encryption but also had cached Okta session cookies in Chromium profile. No evidence of successful privileged actions since 2026-02-20. Risk assessment: medium due to long-lived service credentials and cross-region key usage. Recommended order: disable SSO->revoke tokens->rotate service keys->rekey backups->revoke deploy keys->MDM baseline + wipe policy applied if deviation found.
resolution: (Pending) Temporary mitigation applied: interactive SSO login for emp E-12244 disabled on 2026-03-12 and a temporary admin hold placed on their account. Security started CMK rewrap job in us-west (job id: rewrap-2026-03-12-01) and scheduled eu-west rewrap for 2026-03-13. GitHub deploy keys have been flagged for rotation; PRs created to replace keys (see related_github_prs). HR and Security agreed to a 30-day retention exception; exception doc to be uploaded to Confluence. Final step: once keys rewrapped and deploy keys replaced, IT will run remote verification and then either wipe or formally transfer laptop under signed agreement. Owner for sign-off: K. Patel (Security) and J. Liu (HR).
